Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Pacers.

Bottom line: the Thunder win 61 times in 100, by about 4; most games like this end between 197 and 245 total points.

analyst.text: Both teams are on the second night of a back-to-back. OKC's availability hinges on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's back and neck, with a long list of rotation players already out; Indiana have lost three straight, with Haliburton (at least two more weeks) and McConnell out and Pascal Siakam questionable with a hip issue. With so much uncertainty the angle is close to neutral, tilting to OKC only if Shai plays.
